label: Sleeping Beauty exact incompatible updating bundles
paraphrase: For every nonnegative normalized rational allocation h,m,t over the three declared centers, N and M force t=0; N,M,P are incompatible; N,M,S are incompatible; and N with positive Tuesday mass forces the Monday conditional Heads probability above one half. N and M alone are compatible. All are consequences within one fixed centered measure, not an assertion of which update rule is rational.
